name: slack-mcp
description: MCP server for Slack workspaces using session tokens. Automatic browser-based token extraction, stealth reads, channel caching.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: What needs you: new since your last dismiss, unreads, or mentions

tools.name: messages
tools.description: Read a conversation, context around a message, a time window, or search with Slack query syntax

tools.name: estate
tools.description: Workspace shape and relationships: people, channels, families, initiatives, convergence

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run a plan of read calls in one request, with saved playbooks

tools.name: say
tools.description: Post a message or add or remove an emoji reaction

tools.name: put
tools.description: Write a new file into the exchange directory for say to attach

tools.name: unlock
tools.description: Open a local page to review and clear safety locks

xoxc_token.title: Slack xoxc Token
xoxc_token.description: Session token from Slack. Auto-discovered from ~/.config/slack-mcp/config.json if blank. Run the auth tool to configure.

xoxd_token.title: Slack xoxd Cookie
xoxd_token.description: Session cookie from Slack. Auto-discovered from ~/.config/slack-mcp/config.json if blank. Run the auth tool to configure.
